topics.title: Numbers 99,999 tak
topics.description: 5-digit place value, compare, order, round off, Roman numbers to 100
topics.lesson:
## HOOK
Sab se bara 5-digit number kaun sa hai? 99,999. Grade 4 yahin tak hai — 1 lakh (100,000) Grade 5 ka hissa hai.

## SAMJHAO
5-digit number: ten-thousands, thousands, hundreds, tens, ones.
Example 74,001: 7 ten-thousands, 4 thousands, 0 hundreds, 0 tens, 1 one.
Compare with >, <, =. Order chhote se bara. Round off nearest 10, 100, 1,000, 10,000.
Roman numbers 100 tak: I V X L C.

## MISAAL
Islamabad school: 12,480 students. Is number ko words mein likho aur 12,500 par round karo (nearest hundred).

## KARO
Apna roll-number style 5-digit number banao, expanded form likho, phir nearest ten par round karo.

## SAWAAL
1. Sab se chhota 5-digit number?
2. 99,999 kitne digits?
3. Roman C kis number ke barabar?

topics.title: Number operations
topics.description: Add and subtract up to 5 digits; multiply and divide 4-digit by 1 or 2 digits
topics.lesson:
## HOOK
Bazaar bill: 12,450 + 8,375. Phir 4,200 ko 12 se multiply. Yeh Grade 4 operations hain.

## SAMJHAO
Add aur subtract 5-digit numbers, regrouping ke sath. Estimate pehle, phir exact.
Multiply 4-digit × 1-digit ya 2-digit. Divide 4-digit ÷ 1-digit ya 2-digit. Word problems mein sahi operation chuno.

## MISAAL
Stationery: 2,450 copies × 12. Pehle estimate ~2,500 × 10 = 25,000, phir exact.

## KARO
Teen 5-digit numbers likho, do add karo, teesre se subtract karo. Check: answer reasonable hai?

## SAWAAL
1. 5-digit add kis grade mein?
2. 4-digit × 2-digit allowed?
3. Estimate kyun?

topics.title: Factors aur multiples
topics.description: Divisibility by 2, 3, 5 and 10; factor pairs; prime and composite up to 50
topics.lesson:
## HOOK
24 kin numbers se poora divide hota hai? 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, 24 — yeh factors hain.

## SAMJHAO
Factor = wo number jo poora divide kare. Multiple = table. Divisibility: 2 (even), 5 (0 ya 5), 10 (0), 3 (digits ka sum 3 se). Prime = sirf 1 aur khud (2,3,5,7… 50 tak). Composite = zyada factors. Common factors aur common multiples bhi.

## MISAAL
30 divisible by 2, 3, 5 aur 10. 30 prime nahi, composite hai.

## KARO
1 se 30 tak primes circle karo. 36 ke factor pairs likho.

## SAWAAL
1. 2 ka rule?
2. 1 prime hai?
3. 50 tak prime ya composite kaun seekhte hain?

topics.title: Fractions operations
topics.description: Like and unlike add/subtract; multiply fractions; divide a fraction by a whole number only
topics.lesson:
## HOOK
Pizza 3/4 minus 1/4. Phir 1/2 × 1/3. Grade 4 yahan tak — do fractions ko ek doosre se divide nahi (wo Grade 5).

## SAMJHAO
Proper, improper, mixed. Unlike fractions ko equivalent bana kar add/subtract. Multiply fraction × whole number, aur do fractions multiply. Divide: fraction ÷ whole number (jaise 1/2 ÷ 2). Do fractions ka division is grade ka hissa nahi.

## MISAAL
Library 2/3 km, phir ghar 1/6 km. Total = 4/6 + 1/6 = 5/6 km.

## KARO
Do unlike fractions add karo. Ek fraction ko 3 se divide karo (matlab ÷ 3).

## SAWAAL
1. Unlike add kaise?
2. Fraction ÷ fraction Grade 4?
3. Mixed number kya?

topics.title: Decimals
topics.description: Up to 3 decimal places, operations, fraction to decimal, percent as per hundred
topics.lesson:
## HOOK
0.5 aur 1/2 ek hi baat. 25% matlab 25/100.

## SAMJHAO
Tenths, hundredths, thousandths. Place value 3 decimal places tak. Fraction jiska denominator 10, 100, 1000 ho usay decimal. Compare, round. Add, subtract, multiply, divide decimals (1-digit / 2-digit, aur ×÷ 10 ya 100). % = parts per hundred.

## MISAAL
Rs 12.50 + Rs 3.25 = Rs 15.75. 1/4 = 0.25 = 25%.

## KARO
Teen prices likho, add karo, phir 10 se multiply karke shift dekho.

## SAWAAL
1. 0.1 kis place?
2. 50% fraction?
3. 3 decimal places allowed?

topics.title: Naap conversions
topics.description: km m cm mm, kg g, L ml, and 12-hour / 24-hour time
topics.lesson:
## HOOK
School 2 km door hai — metres mein kitna? 2 × 1000 = 2000 m.

## SAMJHAO
Length: km, m, cm, mm. Mass: kg, g, mg. Capacity: L, ml. Bara unit se chhote mein convert (×). Add/subtract same unit. Time: analog + digital, 12-hour aur 24-hour, hours minutes seconds, start/end se duration.

## MISAAL
1 km 250 m = 1250 m. 3:00 p.m. = 15:00 (24-hour).

## KARO
Ghar se school ka andaaza km mein likho, metres mein badlo. Subah 7:30 ko 24-hour mein likho.

## SAWAAL
1. 1 km = ? m
2. 15:00 kaun sa time?
3. ml kis cheez ka unit?

topics.title: Area aur perimeter
topics.description: Perimeter and area of square, rectangle, and simple rectilinear shapes
topics.lesson:
## HOOK
Maidan ke gird wire = perimeter. Andar jitni zameen = area.

## SAMJHAO
Perimeter: boundary length (square 4×side, rectangle 2×(l+b)). Area: square side×side, rectangle length×breadth. Units alag: perimeter m/cm, area square units. Grid par irregular shape ka area bhi count ho sakta hai.

## MISAAL
Kamra 6 m × 4 m. Perimeter 20 m, area 24 square m.

## KARO
Apni copy ka length/breadth measure karo, perimeter aur area nikaalo.

## SAWAAL
1. Perimeter kya napta hai?
2. Rectangle area formula?
3. Area ki unit?

topics.title: Geometry angles
topics.description: Acute, right and obtuse angles; measure and draw with a protractor up to 180°
topics.lesson:
## HOOK
Kitab ka kona right angle hai. Kholti hui kitab obtuse ban sakti hai.

## SAMJHAO
Acute < 90°, right = 90°, obtuse > 90° aur < 180°. Protractor se measure aur draw, 180° tak. Angles ko size se compare/order karo. Parallel aur non-parallel lines pehchano.

## MISAAL
Clock 3:00 = right angle. Thori si khuli darwaza = acute.

## KARO
Class mein 3 angles dhoondo: acute, right, obtuse. Protractor se ek 60° banao.

## SAWAAL
1. Right angle kitne degrees?
2. Obtuse kis se bara?
3. Protractor kis had tak?

topics.title: Circle aur symmetry
topics.description: Radius, diameter, circumference; line of symmetry in 2-D shapes
topics.lesson:
## HOOK
Coin circle hai. Beech se line — dono halves same? Woh line of symmetry.

## SAMJHAO
Radius = centre se boundary. Diameter = 2 × radius. Circumference = circle ka perimeter. Line of symmetry shape ko identical halves mein kaat-ti hai. 2-D shapes par symmetry dhoondo aur complete karo.

## MISAAL
Plate ka diameter 20 cm, radius 10 cm. Butterfly aksar ek line of symmetry.

## KARO
Paper fold karke ek symmetrical shape banao. Circle ke centre se radius mark karo.

## SAWAAL
1. Diameter radius se kitna?
2. Circumference kya hai?
3. Symmetry line kya karti hai?

topics.title: Data handling
topics.description: Single and double bar graphs; simple chance words (certain, likely, impossible)
topics.lesson:
## HOOK
Class mein favourite fruit: bar graph se foran pata chalta hai kaun sab se zyada.

## SAMJHAO
Horizontal aur vertical bar graphs, single aur double. Read aur draw. Simple probability: impossible, unlikely, equally likely, likely, certain — dice ya spinner par.

## MISAAL
Monday 12 students present, Tuesday 15. Double bar se do weeks compare.

## KARO
5 doston ka favourite colour count karo, bar graph banao.

## SAWAAL
1. Bar graph kya dikhata hai?
2. Certain matlab?
3. Double bar kyun?
